title: Duplicate Claim Check
walkthroughSteps: Apply an AC — injects matching claims and lands on /fnol/loss-information already past the search step

walkthroughSteps.title: Cause of loss
walkthroughSteps.body: Together with Date of occurrence, this drives the duplicate check below — matching happens on policy + date + cause.

walkthroughSteps.title: Date of occurrence
walkthroughSteps.body: Changing this (or the cause above) re-fires the duplicate check on a ~1s debounce — a brief 'Checking for duplicate claims…' spinner shows first.

walkthroughSteps.title: Duplicate warning
walkthroughSteps.body: Lists up to 3 matches — each claim ID is a real deep link (opens /claims/:id in a new tab, FNOL state stays intact on return). Past 3 matches, a 'Show all N duplicates' button opens a sortable table with every match. The banner is dismissible and never blocks the wizard's Next button.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Duplicate banner appears when policy + DoL + cause match an existing claim
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: On `/fnol/loss-information`, entering **DoL** and **cause of loss** for a policy that already has a matching claim shows a *warning banner* listing the existing claim.

setup.description: Inject CLM-DUP-001 matching POL-2024-001 + 2024-06-01 + cause 'fire'; seed FNOL policy

preconditions.text: FNOL is past the search step — selected policy POL-2024-001
preconditions.hint: Banner pre-selects the policy so the user lands on loss-information

preconditions.text: Existing claim CLM-DUP-001 has the same policy + lossDate + cause
After filling DoL=01-06-2024 and Cause=Fire, the warning banner appears
preconditions.hint: Wait ~1s after entering values for the debounced check to fire

claimsAppend.description: Seeded duplicate-test claim — fire damage at warehouse.

expectedUI.description: After entering DoL and cause, the warning banner shows 1 duplicate with link
visualCues: Warning banner (nx-message context='warning') visible
Banner copy: '1 existing claim was found with the same policy, date, and cause of loss'
Banner lists CLM-DUP-001 with date 01-06-2024, client 'Liver Tea Group', status 'Open'
Claim ID is a clickable link

howToTest.trigger: Fill 'Date of occurrence' = 01-06-2024 and Cause of loss = 'Fire'
howToTest.expectedResult: After ~1s debounce, warning banner shows CLM-DUP-001

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Duplicate check fires automatically on cause + date change (debounced)
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The duplicate check *fires automatically* when **cause of loss** or **date of occurrence** changes, with a `1s debounce`. **NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** literal AC-02 said *date-only* trigger; implementation uses *cause+date* per DESIGN DECISION FNOL-DUP-4 (cause-aware narrowing avoids false positives). Treated as `done` — pending product sign-off.

setup.description: Same as AC-01 — single duplicate seeded

preconditions.text: FNOL is past the search step — selected policy POL-2024-001
Loading indicator briefly appears while the debounced check is in flight
Banner appears within ~2s of last keystroke

expectedUI.description: Loading indicator appears, then banner — no manual submit required
visualCues: While typing/changing fields, no banner is shown
After ~1s debounce, 'Checking for duplicate claims…' appears briefly
Banner replaces loading indicator with the duplicate result

howToTest.trigger: Type DoL '01-06-2024'; pause typing; change cause of loss
howToTest.expectedResult: Loading indicator → warning banner. Each cause/date change re-fires after debounce.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each duplicate row shows claim ID, loss date, client name, status
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Each row in the duplicate list shows the **claim ID** (link), **loss date**, **client name**, and **status**. **NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** literal AC-03 also called for separate `claimNumber` and policy number columns; current preview row shows only the four fields above (`step-loss-information.component.html:42–43`). Treated as `done` — pending product sign-off on whether to add the extra columns.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Clicking a duplicate claim link opens it in a new tab
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The duplicate claim ID is a *deep-link* — clicking opens **/claims/:id** in a `new tab` (`target='_blank'` with `rel='noopener'`).

preconditions.text: Click CLM-DUP-001 in the banner — the existing claim opens in a new tab
FNOL state still intact when returning — banner still visible

visualCues: Right-click → 'Open in new tab' equivalent works
Cmd/Ctrl-click opens new tab
FNOL wizard state preserved on return

howToTest.trigger: Click a duplicate claim ID in the banner

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Banner is dismissible and the user can proceed
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The banner has a **close (×)** button — dismissing it lets the user *continue the FNOL flow* without resolving the duplicate. (Proceed is implicit via the wizard's Next/Continue button.)

setup.description: Single duplicate so banner appears and can be dismissed

preconditions.text: Click × on the banner — banner disappears
After dismiss, Next/Continue still works in the wizard footer

expectedUI.description: Banner closable; Next button continues the wizard
visualCues: × icon visible top-right of banner
Click × → banner removed from DOM
Form remains valid for navigation if other required fields are filled

howToTest.trigger: Surface banner; click ×; confirm Next button still navigates

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When more than 3 duplicates match, 'Show all' opens a modal listing them
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: If **>3 duplicates** match, the banner shows the *first 3* and a `Show all N duplicates` button — clicking it opens a modal with a *sortable table* listing every duplicate.
